meta.title: Configuration for Event: Awarding method changes to multiple vendors and saves successfully

steps.note: Create the eRFX draft used by the test.
Provide the required event title before saving the draft.
Configure the eRFX draft with the RFQ stage under test.
Apply an RFQ template so the draft is valid and editable.
Add the required RFQ line item.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before saving.
Commit a schedule so the draft can be saved successfully.
Save the eRFX event as the starting draft state.
Confirm the draft save completed without an application error.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify the saved event appears among drafts.
Open this plan's saved draft; drafts reopen on their create screen.

args.goal: On the saved eRFX draft, open the RFQ stage's Configuration for Event window, select "I may partially award the event to multiple vendors", click Save, and stop on the draft create screen showing that the RFQ awarding method has updated to multiple vendors.

steps.note: Perform and verify the RFQ configuration change and save operation, which has no dedicated catalog step.

args.text: I may partially award the event to multiple vendors

steps.note: Assert the multiple-vendor awarding method is shown after the configuration is saved.
